subject: Track P: agents can now run collection
body: Start with 'python3 -m autoresearch.taste.trackp status'. Its 'next' list gives the commands. Agents use 'pending' (JSON) + 'record --id --choice'; runbook in docs/trackp-runbook.md. David: label prompts allow-list your evidence keys (trackp.EVIDENCE_SHOWN) because D1 priority/measured, D3 decisive and D6 supported/reasons reveal the loop's choice. A new evidence key stays hidden until it's added there.
